# TLM Learnings

Patterns the TLM reviewer missed in past reviews. Injected into every review
so we don't repeat the same mistakes.

<!--
HOW THIS FILE WORKS:

The TLM PR Review workflow reads this file and includes its contents in the
Claude review prompt. When blocking issues are found, the workflow can
automatically append new patterns here.

This creates a self-improvement loop:
1. TLM reviews PRs and catches issues
2. If it misses something, a human catches it
3. The pattern is added here
4. Future reviews check for that pattern explicitly

FORMAT FOR NEW ENTRIES:

## [Date] -- [Short description of the pattern]

**What was missed**: Describe what the reviewer failed to catch.

**Pattern to flag**: Describe the code pattern to watch for.

**Correct pattern**: Show the right way to do it.
